With their constant bickering, their constant arguing, their constant fights. And it always came back to him. "Is this my fault," he thinks to himself, "did I bring this on myself? am I responsible for what happened to them?" For all their constant struggles, his parents still loved him, for all their vices they were still his parents and tried to do their best by him.
